subject: Mid-cycle capacity uplift: synchronized renewal options and surge credit proposal

Subject: Mid-cycle uplift / Q4 surge — options + timing

Hi Naomi,

Hope you’re well. Quick note from our side: product roadmap shifted and we now expect a 3x increase in inference volume for a 6–8 week window starting mid-October. Our procurement lead asked if we can do a mid-cycle uplift that either (a) top-ups capacity pro-rated to our renewal date, or (b) a short-term surge credit we can use and reconcile at renewal.

We’re aiming to finalize commercial terms by Oct 1 so we can get legal/PO in place. Attached is a rough capacity estimate (parallax_capacity_estimate.xlsx) and a usage snapshot. Can you share available options and ballpark economics? Also flag any lead time for provisioning if we go the dedicated capacity route.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if that’s easier.

Aisha Khan
Head of Platform Partnerships
Parallax AI
Aisha.khan@parallax.ai

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-12T17:38:00Z
Subject: RE: Mid-cycle uplift / Q4 surge — options + timing

Thanks Aisha — got the estimate. We can support the Q4 spike; below are three paths with rough economics (high-level). I attached a formatted breakdown (uplift-options.pdf) and a usage snapshot we pulled (PAR-usage-snapshot.csv).

Option A — Short-term surge credit (fastest)
- One-time token credit redeemable over 8 weeks
- No change to contract; credits applied against usage at invoice time
- Typical provisioning: immediate for burst on hosted; Dedicated pool requires 5–7 business days if GPU reservation needed
- Ballpark cost: $50k one-time credit to cover estimated peak (discountable)

Option B — Pro-rated top-up + co-term at renewal
- Add a pro-rated committed bucket that co-terms with your existing renewal (Nov 30 2027)
- Pro-rate based on months remaining, with a blended unit rate (5–12% uplift vs list depending on commit)
- Provisioning for Dedicated: ~7 days; Hosted: immediate

Option C — Annualize now (move some capacity forward into an early renewal)
- Move to an annualized uplift at a reduced blended price (12–20% off list for 12+ month renewals)
- Requires amendment and PO; gives predictable unit economics for 12 months

Suggested next steps: confirm preferred option and target throughput (tokens/sec or avg tokens/day), we’ll model exact $s and get internal approvals. If you want Option B/C we’ll need a PO and signed amendment; I can send a DocuSign when you’re ready.

If helpful, propose a 30-min call tomorrow (Tue 9/13 10:30 PT) to walk through numbers.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Account Executive — Growth
Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai
